J-1 Lambda_QCD from FSOT alpha_s(M_Z).physics: MSbar Lambda by the exact-integral definition ln(mu^2/Lambda^2) = 1/(b0 a) + (b1/b0^2) ln(b0 a) + int_0^a [1/B(x) + 1/(b0 x^2) - b1/(b0^2 x)] dx, B = -x^2 (b0 + b1 x + b2 x^2 + b3 x^3), 4-loop coefficients (PDG 2024 QCD review eq. 9.4), 48-point Gauss-Legendre; alpha_s at other scales by inverting the same relation (= exact 4-loop running). Lambda^(4), Lambda^(3): decoupling at mu = m_b(m_b), m_c(m_c) with the 3-loop MSbar relation alpha^(nl) = alpha^(nl+1)[1 + (11/72) a^2 + (564731/124416 - 82043/27648 zeta3 - 2633/31104 nl) a^3], a = alpha^(nl+1)/pi (Chetyrkin-Kniehl-Steinhauser, NPB 510 (1998) 61).
